text:
"Best recommendations! It was the most discreet freezing injection! Very gentle treatment. I was pleased with the treatment process." - that's what I wrote and gave it 5* immediately after the treatment. And now, almost three weeks have passed. I'm changing my review.
For several days after the treatment, my tooth was sensitive to hot and cold. I thought it would calm down soon. Then, gradually, a dull, wandering pain developed along the entire right side of my jaw. I assumed I had a muscle injury and that this was the result. Eventually, I realized the source of the pain was the tooth I had treated at this clinic. I wrote to the doctor about the problem, and she invited me to come. I insisted that a repeat repair would be covered by warranty.
I arrived at the clinic, the doctor examined me, took an X-ray, and...she said: you need to have the root canals cleaned, removing the nerves in your tooth, there's inflammation there, and it will cost 10,000 baht!!! I refused. They also wanted to charge me 300 baht for the X-ray!!!
Now I seriously doubt the professionalism of this clinic!
Why, when I first visited, didn't the doctor immediately take an X-ray or tell me that I NEEDED a nerve removal? Instead, she simply filled it under anesthesia (she knew my tooth was hurting) for 1,500 baht, and that led to further pain in my mouth!? So, I wasted 1,500 baht just to have a hole filled (in about 40 minutes) with no guarantee of pain relief!
I hope the pain goes away and I don't have to return to my country early for dental treatment!
This is an extremely strange approach to treatment. Perhaps this is customary in Thailand.
